notifications.title: Your notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose how AgriPulse reaches you when an alert or a recommendation opens on a farm you can see.
notifications.loadFailed: Could not load your notification settings.
notifications.saveFailed: Could not save. Your settings were not changed.
notifications.scopeNote: These settings are yours alone. They do not change what anyone else on your farm receives.
notifications.allOff: You will not be notified at all.
notifications.allOffDetail: Alerts and recommendations still open in the Action Center. Nothing is lost — you will only see them when you go looking.

channels.heading: How to reach you
channels.hint: Every channel you tick gets the same alert. Untick the ones you do not want.

in_app.label: In the app
in_app.hint: Shows on the bell in the top bar.

email.label: Email
email.hint: Sent to the address on your account.

push.label: Phone notification
push.hint: Needs the AgriPulse app signed in on a phone.

reason.tenant_disabled: Your organisation has this channel switched off, so nothing is being sent on it. An administrator can turn it back on in Settings.
reason.no_email_address: Your account has no email address, so nothing can be sent.
reason.no_registered_device: No phone is signed in to the AgriPulse app, so nothing can be sent yet. Sign in on a phone and this starts working.

language.label: Language of your notifications
language.hint: Sets the language of the emails and the bell. It does not change the language of this website.
